exposure: Topical hemostatic agent use during primary cesarean delivery
outcome: Uterine scar disruption (rupture or dehiscence) at the subsequent trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: 7199 women who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean delivery
finding: A history of hemostatic agent use during cesarean delivery was not associated with an increased risk for uterine scar disruption after subsequent TOLAC.
